description: Counterparty-bank and wire screening: give a BIC (SWIFT), IBAN, US ABA routing number or LEI, and/or a bank name and country, optionally the beneficiary name. Returns allow / review / block with reasons: identifier checksum, the institution from GLEIF (legal name, country, status), jurisdiction lists (FATF call-for-action and increased monitoring, EU high-risk third countries, FinCEN Section 311 jurisdictions, comprehensive US sanctions programmes), the bank on sanctions lists, FinCEN 311 / 9714 institutions, and enforcement actions naming the bank. Use before releasing a wire, onboarding a correspondent or paying a new supplier's bank. Free plan.

beneficiary_name.description: Beneficiary (payee) name on the wire, screened against sanctions lists

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bank, if known

identifier.description: BIC (e.g. DEUTDEFF), IBAN, 9-digit ABA routing number or 20-char LEI

name.description: Bank name (used when the identifier is missing or cannot be resolved)
